description: This file defines a PHP class 'AOS_InvoicesViewEdit' which extends 'ViewEdit' and customizes the display of the invoice editing view by populating invoice template options from the database.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesViewEdit
classes.description: A subclass of ViewEdit that customizes invoice editing view by populating invoice templates.
